metadata.title: Conformome pilot release v0.1.0: conformational-state evidence records for proteins and nucleic acids
metadata.description:
Data release of Conformome (https://conformome.org), an index of experimental and computational evidence on the conformational states of proteins, RNA and DNA. The pilot covers 83 molecules: 81 proteins, the Vibrio vulnificus adenine riboswitch aptamer (RNA) and the human telomeric G-quadruplex (DNA). The corpus holds 17,541 evidence entries from eight ingested sources (RCSB PDB, BMRB, SASBDB, DisProt, AlphaFold DB, MDDB, NAKB and Rfam; RNAcentral supplies RNA identifiers), of which 14,953 are archived here; the 2,588 SMASH-BIO force-spectroscopy entries are linked at source because their data licence is not stated. 31 molecules carry draft curation with 71 conformational states (3 for nucleic acids). Contains all archived molecule, state, transition, evidence and model records (all-records.jsonl), one JSON bundle per molecule, the JSON Schemas, the technique taxonomy, the per-molecule curation files (states, curator assignments and mapping rules), the manifest of raw inputs with URLs, retrieval dates and SHA-256 checksums, and EXCLUDED.tsv listing what was left out and why. See README.md for file descriptions, identifier schemes and source attributions.

Generated by the Conformome pipeline, version 0.1.0, from repository commit dcf432a (software DOI: see related identifiers).
